metadata.description: Tuncer's Claude Code mods, kept in sync across his machines

plugins.name: memory-guards
plugins.description: Refuses the footgun commands Claude's memory notes warn about, with the reason and the safe alternative

plugins.name: kb-health
plugins.description: KB health in the status line on the machine that runs the KB; stays quiet everywhere else

plugins.name: machine-tag
plugins.description: Prefixes session titles with this machine's emoji tag, so pinned sessions show which computer they run on

plugins.name: pin-everywhere
plugins.description: Pinning a session turns on Remote Control so it shows with its name and machine icon on every computer and the phone; unpinning turns it back off
